results.title: Price for Salesforce: 2026 CRM Pricing Breakdown
results.content:
Salesforce offers three different pricing plans for its Sales Cloud. It’s also worth noting that the Service Cloud from Salesforce follows the same pricing model, with the same plans at the same price point.

 Enterprise – $175 per user, per month
 Unlimited – $350 per user, per month
 Agentforce 1 Sales – $550 per user, per month

The Enterprise plan is a big upgrade from the Suite plans because it adds a lot of analytics tools, including cross filters and joined reports. [...] Salesforce pricing starts at $25 per user, per month, for the Starter Suite, which provides users with basic sales, service, and marketing tools.
 Salesforce offers a free forever plan for up to two users.
 Salesforce offers industry-specific “Clouds” for sales, service, and marketing, which start at $195 per user, per month. [...] Agentforce 1 Editions ($550 per user, per month): These are specific all-in-one bundles that give you unmetered access to Agentforce in the Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, as well as $2.5m Flex Credit per organization, per year.
 Agentforce add-on ($125 per user, per month): Agentforce can also be added to less expensive plans in the Sales, Service, and Field Service Clouds. For any other industry cloud, you’ll have to pay $150 per user, per month.

results.title: Sales Program Pricing
results.content:
Salesforce Program pricing varies depending on the edition and number of users. Pricing starts at $100 USD per user per month. Contact us to talk about your specific business needs and use cases.

### Does the cost of Sales Programs change based on my Sales Cloud edition?

The overall cost of Sales Programs depends on the number of user licenses you wish to add, not on your Sales Cloud edition.

### Can I get a free trial of Salesforce Sales Programs?
